title: Tech Note: A Simple and Ready-to-Use Installer, Part 1

historical_commentary.text: This note provides a simple, ready-to-use installer solution for 4D applications, addressing common deployment issues like incomplete file copies and read-only attributes on Windows. Building custom installers was a common necessity in the late 1990s before standardized installer frameworks became widespread. Modern 4D's Build Application feature and standard OS-level installer tools have entirely replaced this approach.
related_updates: 4D's Build Application dialog now handles application packaging and deployment
Standard installer technologies (macOS .pkg/.dmg, Windows .msi/MSIX) have replaced custom 4D-based installers
